chapter: Blackbirds, Carmen Jones and the Ziegfeld Follies
title: Getting into Lew Leslie's Blackbirds in 1929
summary: The lawyer tells them to wait for a better case against the Canadian manager, and Lew Leslie hires them with Ethel Waters and the Berry Brothers.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: But anyway, getting back to when we come out of Canada and come back to talk to the lawyer and the lawyer says he's got to get something better or a better platform to go against the manager than that. I says, okay, I'll wait. So we waited. Went into "Blackbirds" after that in 1929.
How did you get that job?
Through Lew Leslie. He wanted to get all colored entertainment for the show. He got Ethel Waters, he got The Berry Brothers, Buck and Bubbles and oh, several others.
Wasn't Bill Robinson also in it?
No, that was another one. He wasn't in the one I was in, no.
